page.overview:
Who is Teire Alentaine?

Teire Alentaine is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

Teire has a One Power strength of , making her weak for an Aes Sedai. She would be unable to Travel without linking with another sister.

Teire was part of Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's secret expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien. After kidnapping Rand and escaping capture during the Battle of Dumai's Wells she flees to Dorlan along with other sisters under the leadership of Covarla Baldene.

After Elaida learned of the failure from Dumai's Wells, she ordered the sisters to remain in Dorlan and sent Narenwin Barda to take command of the group.
